heading.purpose: UI chrome titles: dialog titles, card titles, drawer titles, popover titles. EB Garamond at 500 weight, text-sm.

body.purpose: Default UI text. Inter at 400 weight, text-xs/relaxed (~0.75rem/1.6). Content areas scale to text-sm (0.875rem).

label.purpose: Badges, buttons, navigation triggers. Inter at 500 weight, text-[0.625rem].

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Popovers, select dropdowns, and floating menus only.

shadows.name: dialog-overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialog backdrop — darkness conveys depth, not shadow.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions (hover, focus, enter/exit).

motion.name: duration-default
motion.purpose: Default transition duration for dialogs, popovers, drawers, and tooltips.

motion.name: animate-fade-zoom
motion.purpose: Enter/exit animation for dialogs, popovers, tooltips. Scale from 95% with simultaneous fade.

motion.name: active-press
motion.value: translate-y-px on :active for buttons without aria-haspopup
motion.purpose: 1px downward shift on button press — tactile feedback.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Solid dark block on light background, inverted in dark mode. 28px tall, sharp corners, compact label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); padding: 0 0.5rem; height: 1.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.1s, transform 0.1s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.205 0 0 / 0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action. Transparent with a hairline border. Fills on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); padding: 0 0.5rem; height: 1.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.25rem; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 0.1s, color 0.1s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.5); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.3); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Minimal button for icon-only actions, close buttons, and toolbar items. No border, transparent background. Fills on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M18 6 6 18"/><path d="m6 6 12 12"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); padding: 0; width: 1.5rem; height: 1.5rem; border: none; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background-color 0.1s; outline: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-btn-ghost svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input with recessed appearance. 28px tall, semi-transparent background, sharp corners. Two-part focus ring on interaction.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 1.75rem; width: 100%; min-width: 0; border-radius: 0; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.2); padding: 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); outline: none; transition: border-color 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 0.2); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Quiet container with subtle ring boundary. No shadow. 0.5rem corners — softer than inputs but sharper than dialogs.
components.html:
Card Title

Description text goes here.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 1rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'EB Garamond Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; margin: 0; } .ds-card-desc { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); margin: 0; }

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill-shaped metadata tag. 20px tall, 10px font. Solid dark in default variant, outline in secondary.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 1.25rem; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.625rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); transition: background-color 0.1s; } .ds-badge-outline { background: oklch(0.922 0 0 / 0.2); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); border-color: oklch(0.922 0 0); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal overlay with rounded corners and subtle ring. 80% black backdrop with blur. Centered, zoom-in animation.
components.html:
Dialog Title

Dialog content text.
components.css: .ds-dialog-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 50; background: oklch(0 0 0 / 0.8); backdrop-filter: blur(2px); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-dialog { position: relative; width: 100%; max-width: calc(100% - 2rem); display: grid; gap: 1rem; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 1rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-dialog-in 0.1s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-dialog-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } .ds-dialog-title { font-family: 'EB Garamond Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; margin: 0; } .ds-dialog-body { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); margin: 0; }

components.name: Popover
components.description: Floating menu with shadow and ring. 288px max-width. The only surface with a consistent drop shadow.
components.css: .ds-popover { z-index: 50; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; width: 18rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 0.625rem; font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 2px 4px -2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 0.1); animation: ds-popover-in 0.1s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-popover-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } } .ds-popover-item { padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 0.25rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-popover-item:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); }

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Inverted label — dark background with light text (or vice versa in dark mode). Compact, with a small arrow.
components.css: .ds-tooltip { z-index: 50; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; max-width: 20rem; border-radius: 0; background: oklch(0.145 0 0); color: oklch(1 0 0); padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; animation: ds-tooltip-in 0.1s ease-out; } @keyframes ds-tooltip-in { from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95); } to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); } }

components.name: Navigation Trigger
components.description: Horizontal nav item with chevron dropdown indicator. 36px tall, rounded-lg, fills on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-nav-trigger">Posts <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-nav-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 2.25rem; gap: 0.25rem; padding: 0.375rem 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.1s; outline: none; } .ds-nav-trigger:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-nav-trigger:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 0.3); } .ds-nav-trigger svg { width: 12px; height: 12px; transition: transform 0.3s; } .ds-nav-trigger[aria-expanded="true"] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); }

narrative.overview:
A darkroom at work: quiet, focused, with content emerging into view like a print developing in chemical bath. The interface recedes until needed — surfaces are flat at rest, depth signals appear only when interaction demands them. Light text on near-black in dark mode; an unlit tray of clean white in light mode waiting for the first image. Nothing competes with the content for attention.

The system is achromatic by design: every gray is neutral, every surface tonally layered, every piece of chrome strictly functional. The only color with chroma is destructive red — a safety light in the darkroom that must be noticeable. Content (images, embeds, code, the audio visualizer) brings chromatic energy; the UI itself is the tray, the tongs, the timer — essential but invisible.

Density is compact — 12px body type, 28px button height, tight gaps — reflecting a power-user's tools. The workshop metaphor runs deep: tools are at hand via Cmd+K, surfaces are reachable via drawers, the player persists across pages. Nothing is decorative; everything is load-bearing.
keyCharacteristics: Achromatic neutral palette — content provides color, the UI provides structure
Flat-at-rest surfaces with tonal layering — depth is quiet, shadows are transient
Compact density — tools feel precise, deliberate, fast
Sharp-cornered (--radius: 0rem) with exceptions at dialog (rounded-xl) and drawer (rounded-xl)
EB Garamond headings add a single note of editorial warmth against Inter's technical clarity
Zero ornament — every visible element is interactive, informative, or structural

rules.name: The Monochrome Rule
rules.body: No color accent beyond the achromatic scale and destructive red. Content (images, embeds, syntax highlighting, the audio spectrum visualizer) provides all chromatic energy. The UI itself stays in grayscale.

rules.name: The Safety Light Rule
rules.body: Destructive red appears only on destructive actions, error states, and invalid indicators. Never decorative. If you see red, pay attention — something needs action.

rules.name: The Garamond Restraint
rules.body: EB Garamond appears only in UI chrome titles — dialog titles, card titles, drawer titles, popover titles. Never in body text, never in navigation, never in content headings. Its warmth is a spice, not a sauce.

rules.name: The Compact Default
rules.body: Body size defaults to text-xs (12px) across the UI shell. Content areas (posts, prose, services page) may scale to text-sm (14px), but chrome stays compact. Power-user density is the baseline; spaciousness is opt-in per route.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest — cards, inputs, buttons in their default state — use only tonal difference and subtle rings to define their boundaries. Shadows appear only as a response to state: hover elevation, popover expansion, dialog overlay. If nothing is happening, nothing is floating.

rules.name: The Ring-Not-Border Rule
rules.body: Component boundaries use ring-1 ring-foreground/10, not border-border. The only components using actual borders are inputs, select triggers, and the header separator. Rings recede; borders declare.

dos: Do use semantic color tokens (bg-background, text-muted-foreground) — never raw color keywords or hex values.
Do use gap-* for all spacing between siblings. space-x-* / space-y-* are banned project-wide.
Do use data-icon="inline-start" or data-icon="inline-end" on icons inside buttons. The button variant handles sizing.
Do use ring-1 ring-foreground/10 for component boundaries on cards, popovers, dialogs, and drawers. Reserve border-border for inputs, selects, and the header.
Do use Skeleton components for loading states — not raw animate-pulse divs.
Do use Drawer (bottom sheets) for mobile full-page interactions. Popover is for desktop dropdowns only.
Do keep body text at text-xs/relaxed in UI chrome. Content areas (posts, prose) may use text-sm.
Do use EB Garamond (font-heading) only in UI title components (dialog titles, card titles, drawer titles, popover titles).
Do use rounded-xl for dialogs and drawers, rounded-lg for cards, and rounded-full for badges. All other components default to rounded-md (effectively sharp at --radius: 0rem).
donts: Don't introduce a new color accent. The system is achromatic. Content provides chromatic energy; the UI stays in grayscale except for destructive red.
Don't add box-shadows to cards, buttons, inputs, or other resting surfaces. Shadows are for floating elements (popovers) and overlays (dialogs).
Don't manually size icons in buttons. The button variant handles it via [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5.
Don't use EB Garamond for body text, navigation labels, or content headings. It's reserved for UI chrome titles.
Don't use animate-pulse on raw divs — use the Skeleton component.
Don't use Popover on mobile for full-page interactions — use Drawer.
Don't set a font-size on heading components that already receive font-heading — the title component variants handle it.
